topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Got a case came my way, a curious one. Client walks in, raincoat dripping, story dripping with betrayal. Seems their partner's been penning a novel, and guess who's the star of the show? Not exactly a Shakespearean romance, more like a tell-all from a two-bit snoop. Now, they're looking for the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but. Thing is, sometimes the truth is a mirror, and folks ain't always ready to see their reflection. Took the case, of course. Gonna get to the bottom of this. A story like this, it needs uncovering, and I'm just the man to do it. Rain or shine, this city's got more secrets than a locked vault, and every story's got a twist. Just gotta find the right angle.
